mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are known as natural gas liquids (NGL)."
Hydrocarbons heavier than methane are known as natural gas liquids (NGL).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the basic raw materials for the manufacture of petrochemicals."
Natural gas and crude oil are the basic raw materials for the manufacture of petrochemicals.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most important stage of a well's life, when the oil and gas are produced."
The production stage is the most important stage of a well's life, when the oil and gas are produced.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a special field of general chemistry."
Petroleum Chemistry is a special field of general chemistry.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process in which the well is enabled to produce oil or gas."
Completion is the process in which the well is enabled to produce oil or gas.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a term commonly used to refer to the refining of crude oil, selling and distribution of natural gas and products derived from crude oil."
The downstream oil sector is a term commonly used to refer to the refining of crude oil, selling and distribution of natural gas and products derived from crude oil.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an isomer having a methyl group branching from carbon number 2 of the main chain."
An isoparaffin is an isomer having a methyl group branching from carbon number 2 of the main chain.

The upstream oil sector is a term commonly used to refer to the searching for and the recovery and production of crude oil and natural gas.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a gas consisting primarily of methane."
Natural gas is a gas consisting primarily of methane.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a sedimentary rock such as shale or limestone that contains between 1and 5% organic carbon."
petroleum source rock is a sedimentary rock such as shale or limestone that contains between 1and 5% organic carbon.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is responsible for the generation of most hydrocarbons."
Thermal breakdown of kerogen is responsible for the generation of most hydrocarbons.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a complex mixture of compounds containing hydrocarbons."
Crude oil is a complex mixture of compounds containing hydrocarbons.

Landfill gas is a type of biogas, but biogas usually refers to gas produced from organic material that has not been mixed with other waste.

Hydrogen sulphide is the only important inorganic sulphur compound found in crude oil.

Oil is derived mainly from marine or lacustrian source rocks, but, since gas can be derived from land plants as well, all source rocks have the potential for gas generation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an active compound that reacts with many reagents."
Urea is an active compound that reacts with many reagents.

Methane hydrates are the most recent form of unconventional natural gas to be discovered and researched.

Odourants are considered non-toxic in the extremely low concentrations occurring in natural gas delivered to the end user.

Shale is a very fine- grained sedimentary rock, which is easily breakable into thin, parallel layers.

Hydrocracking is a catalytic cracking process assisted by the presence of an elevated partial pressure of hydrogen gas.

Diagenesis is a process through which the system tends to approach equilibrium under conditions of shallow burial, and through which the sediment normally becomes consolidated.

Nigeria is the ninth largest gas producer in the world and a major potential gas supplier.

North America is the leading consumer of natural gas, but also is a leading producer.

Hydrogen cyanide (hydrocyanic acid) is a colourless liquid (b.p.25.6°C) that is miscible with water, producing a weakly acidic solution.

Town gas is a mixture of methane and other gases, mainly the highly toxic carbon monoxide that can be used in a similar way to natural gas and can be produced by treating coal chemically.

The octane is one of the molecules found in petrol (gasoline).

Anhydrous ammonia is a fertilizer by direct application to the soil.

Ammonia is the precursor for many other chemicals such as nitric acid, hydrazine, acrylonitrile, and hexamethylenediamine.
